hooks.command: bash -c 'IN=$(cat); S=scripts/seo-recrawl.mjs; R="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; [ -f "$R/$S" ] || R=$(git -C "$(printf %s "$IN" | jq -r ".cwd // empty" 2>/dev/null)" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -f "$R/$S" ]; then printf %s "$IN" | node "$R/$S" hook; else echo "seo-recrawl hook: $S not found from this checkout" >&2; exit 1; fi'
